name: Prisma
description: Prisma MCP integration for Postgres database management, schema migrations, SQL queries, and connection string management. Provision Prisma Postgres databases, run migrations, and interact with your data directly.
longDescription:
Ships **2 MCP servers**, `Prisma-Local`, `Prisma-Remote`.

Installs with `claude plugin install prisma@claude-plugins-official` from `prisma/claude-plugin`.

Prisma MCP integration for Postgres database management, schema migrations, SQL queries, and connection string management. Provision Prisma Postgres databases, run migrations, and interact with your data directly.
